title: Human Authentication Request
description: Request for human interactive authentication following ADR-0006 Authorization Code + PKCE profile.

grant_type.description: OIDC/OAuth grant type (always 'authorization_code' for browser flow)

code_challenge_method.description: PKCE challenge method (must be S256 per ADR-0006)

client_id.description: OAuth client identifier, registered with Baobab IAM

redirect_uri.description: Registered redirect destination (must match exactly per ADR-0006 §11)

state.description: Application state / CSRF token (must be transaction-specific, non-static per ADR-0006 §13)

nonce.description: Transaction-specific nonce for OIDC (must be non-static per ADR-0006 §13)

assurance_level.description: Required authentication assurance level per ADR-IAM-0024
